title: Call-surface change detector + automated rollback playbook
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Problem: When deploying new model variants we observe subtle changes to tool-call shapes (argument names/order/types) and structured outputs that break downstream consumers. Existing detectors are too conservative (many false positives) or too late (caught only after canary traffic). This ticket builds a lightweight runtime call-surface change detector that aggregates shadow-run diffs, computes a graded compatibility score, and feeds into a configurable automated rollback playbook.
goal: Provide an operational component that: 1) flags incompatible call-shape changes before serving significant production traffic; 2) surfaces human-readable diffs that map to SDK/console UX; 3) integrates with rollout controller to perform staged auto-reverts based on tunable thresholds.
design_summary: Approach: instrument the runtime to emit canonicalized call-signatures for every tool invocation (canonicalization rules include renaming normalization, ordering-insensitive argument sets, and typed shape hashes). A shadow-run comparator joins shadow results with golden-run outputs on request-id and computes three classes of deltas: (A) structural (missing/extra fields), (B) semantic-type mismatches (string vs list, numeric ranges), (C) behavioral (different function chosen). Each delta increments weighted counters; the resulting compatibility score is returned to the rollout controller. A separate offline verifier runs a higher-sensitivity static schema diff on model artifacts to seed alerts prior to rollout.
implementation_steps: Instrument runtime to emit canonical signature payloads (compact JSON lines) to a shadow-sink
Build comparator service that pulls paired shadow/golden traces and produces per-request diff summary (structural, type, behavior)
Define scoring heuristic and threshold config; expose via rollout controller API (canary/AB/staged)
Integrate with rollout controller to trigger automated rollback when score < threshold for N sustained minutes or X% of requests
Add SDK/console UX: human-readable diff, sample request viewer, and per-model compatibility history timeline
Create offline static checker that runs on model packaging to detect large structural deltas before any rollout
acceptance_criteria: Detector produces a compatibility score per-minute per-model with <5s processing latency for aggregated window metrics
Automated rollback triggers in staging when configured thresholds are breached and generates an incident log entry
Console shows a per-model diff explainer with example request and highlighted changed fields
False positive rate <= 6% on historical canary traces (validated against curated test set of 2k requests)
Documentation and runbook for SRE and Launch Owners completed and reviewed

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-aggressive auto-reverts could disrupt healthy rollouts. Mitigation: require multi-min window and percent-of-requests condition; provide kill-switch in console.
Risk: Canonicalization may mask true semantic changes. Mitigation: keep raw payload available and add high-sensitivity offline checker for semantic deltas.
Risk: Telemetry volume growth. Mitigation: compact canonical payloads, sample shadow traffic, and provide retention TTL at project level.
release_notes: Adds runtime call-surface comparator and automated rollback playbook. Default enabled for internal canaries; opt-in for customer Dedicated deployments. Console enhancements include human-friendly diffs and historical compatibility timeline.
notes_for_followup: Next phase: extend comparator to handle multi-tool orchestration (chains of function calls) and surface causal traces linking model changes to downstream SDK exceptions. Also add ML-powered suggestion engine to propose safe field mappings based on historical pairs.
